application.title: Support360
application.description: Support ticketing platform for employees to raise issues and support agents/admins to track, assign and resolve tickets with full audit history.

navigation.title: Ticket Management
navigation.description: Employee-facing ticket creation and self-service tracking
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Employee ticket creation and My Tickets tracking

navigation.title: Create Support Ticket
navigation.description: Employee logs a new support ticket
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only transaction to create/edit/delete a support ticket with TICKET_NO (auto), TITLE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS (default Open, read-only), RAISED_BY (VARCHAR(36), mandatory, read-only, visible on the form, auto-populated at runtime with the currently logged-in user's user id; no separate raiser-name column is displayed on the form or in the grid), CREATED_DATE, ATTACHMENT. Mandatory: TITLE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CODE (active Category master), PRIORITY_CODE (active Priority master). Actions: Add, Edit (before assignment), Delete (own ticket while Open), Search. Attachment linked with uploaded-by/uploaded-date. Writes Created entry to Activity/History Log. Inline validation and success messages. The Assign Agent action opens the Ticket Assignment (support360_ticket_assignment) transaction screen for the current ticket. CATEGORY_NAME (VARCHAR(100), read-only, non-editable) is auto-filled from SUPPORT360_CATEGORY_MASTER.CATEGORY_NAME when CATEGORY_CODE is selected. PRIORITY_NAME (VARCHAR(100), read-only, non-editable) is auto-filled from SUPPORT360_PRIORITY_MASTER.PRIORITY_NAME when PRIORITY_CODE is selected. Both are display-only fields shown next to their respective code fields and are not persisted business inputs.

navigation.title: My Tickets
navigation.description: Employee views and tracks own raised tickets
navigation.functional_specs: Row-level restricted to RAISED_BY = current Employee. List TICKET_NO, TITLE, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, ASSIGNED_AGENT, CREATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE. Drill-in shows DESCRIPTION, ATTACHMENT list, AGENT_COMMENTS, ACTIVITY_HISTORY. Actions: Search, Filter (STATUS, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, date range), View, Add-attachment (any status), Confirm-and-close (only when STATUS=Resolved; stamps CLOSED_DATE/CLOSED_BY, updates STATUS=Closed, writes Activity Log entry), Reopen-comment (adds comment, no status change).

navigation.title: Agent Ticket Desk
navigation.description: Support Agent queue management and resolution workflow
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Support Agent ticket queue handling

navigation.title: Manage Ticket Queue
navigation.description: Agent views, works, and resolves tickets
navigation.functional_specs: Actionable tickets: STATUS in (Open, Assigned, In Progress) that are unassigned or assigned to current Agent. Data: TICKET_NO, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, RAISED_BY, ASSIGNED_AGENT, CREATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE, ATTACHMENT list, COMMENT list, RESOLUTION_NOTES. Status flow Open->Assigned->In Progress->Resolved->Closed. STATUS dropdown on Edit offers only Start Progress (In Progress) and Resolved; Assigned is not user-selectable. RESOLUTION_NOTES mandatory before Resolve. Actions: Search, Filter (STATUS, PRIORITY_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE, ASSIGNED_AGENT), Edit, Start-progress, Add-comment, Add-attachment, Resolve. Every change writes a timestamped Activity/History Log entry with old/new value and changed-by. A read-only Assigned To column displays the assigned agent's AGENT_NAME (looked up from SUPPORT360_AGENT), not just the agent code. Support Agents can directly edit ticket fields via the standard Edit action, in addition to the Start Progress/Add Comment/Add Attachment/Resolve actions. Assignment of the Support Agent is not performed on this screen; it happens on the separate Ticket Assignment (support360_ticket_assignment) screen.

navigation.title: Admin Setup
navigation.description: Master data and overarching ticket administration
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Category/Priority master maintenance and full ticket administration

navigation.title: Manage Category Master
navigation.description: Admin defines and maintains ticket categories
navigation.functional_specs: Master with CATEGORY_CODE, CATEGORY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE. CATEGORY_CODE and CATEGORY_NAME mandatory and unique. Cannot delete if referenced by any ticket; can only be deactivated in that case. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate.

navigation.title: Manage Priority Master
navigation.description: Admin defines and maintains priority levels
navigation.functional_specs: Master with PRIORITY_CODE, PRIORITY_NAME, SEQUENCE_NO, IS_ACTIVE. PRIORITY_CODE, PRIORITY_NAME, SEQUENCE_NO mandatory; PRIORITY_CODE and SEQUENCE_NO unique. Cannot delete if referenced by any ticket; can only be deactivated in that case. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate.

navigation.title: Manage Agent Master
navigation.description: Admin maintains the master list of Support Agents with their availability and status.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only transaction screen to create/edit agent records. Fields: AGENT_ID (VARCHAR(20), editable, mandatory, unique identifier for the agent), AGENT_NAME (VARCHAR(100), editable, mandatory), AGENT_AVAILABILITY (VARCHAR(20), dropdown single-select, allowed values Available/Occupied, mandatory), AGENT_STATUS (VARCHAR(20), dropdown single-select, allowed values Active/Inactive, mandatory). Business actions: Add, Edit, Search.

navigation.title: Manage Ticket Assignment
navigation.description: Agent assigns the Support Agent handling a ticket
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only transaction on main_table SUPPORT360_TICKET, PK TICKET_NO. Fields: TICKET_NO (VARCHAR(30), read-only), TITLE (VARCHAR(200), read-only), ASSIGNED_AGENT (VARCHAR(36), editable, lookup to SUPPORT360_AGENT.AGENT_ID where AGENT_STATUS=Active), STATUS (VARCHAR(20), read-only). Opened for a specific ticket from the Create Support Ticket screen's Assign Agent action, passing TICKET_NO as context. Action: Save (update ASSIGNED_AGENT).

navigation.title: Activity & History Log
navigation.description: System-generated, read-only audit trail of ticket changes
navigation.functional_specs: Group for the immutable ticket Activity/History Log

navigation.title: Ticket Activity Log
navigation.description: Read-only chronological record of all ticket changes
navigation.functional_specs: System-generated only, no manual add/edit/delete by any role. Data: TICKET_NO, ACTION_TYPE (Created, Assigned, Status-Changed, Commented, Attachment-Added, Edited, Closed), FIELD_CHANGED, OLD_VALUE, NEW_VALUE, CHANGED_BY, CHANGE_DATE. Actions: Search, View (read-only). Written to automatically by ticket creation, assignment/reassignment, status change, comment, attachment, and edit actions across the app.

navigation.title: Search, Filters & Dashboards
navigation.description: Cross-cutting ticket search grid, detail log and analytical visuals
navigation.functional_specs: Group for shared Visual Schema and BI visuals feeding role dashboards

navigation.title: Ticket Schema
navigation.description: Shared dataset definition for the Ticket fact grain
navigation.functional_specs: Shared Visual Schema over the ticket fact table joined to Category and Priority masters, exposing TICKET_NO, TITLE, STATUS, PRIORITY_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE, RAISED_BY, ASSIGNED_AGENT, CREATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE for reuse by All Tickets, Ticket Count by Status, Ticket Count by Priority, and all Card/Chart visuals at ticket grain.

navigation.title: All Tickets
navigation.description: Grid of all tickets with role-driven filters
navigation.functional_specs: Grid visual on support360_ticket_schema. Criteria: TICKET_NO, STATUS, PRIORITY_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE, ASSIGNED_AGENT, RAISED_BY, CREATED_DATE range. Data points: TICKET_NO, TITLE, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, RAISED_BY, ASSIGNED_AGENT, CREATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE. Row click drills to the ticket detail transaction appropriate to role.

navigation.title: Ticket Count by Status
navigation.description: Column chart of ticket volume by status
navigation.functional_specs: Column-Chart on support360_ticket_schema. Criteria: CREATED_DATE range, CATEGORY_CODE (optional). STATUS (x-axis) vs COUNT_OF_TICKETS (y-axis). Drill to All Tickets filtered by clicked STATUS.

navigation.title: Ticket Count by Priority
navigation.description: Pie chart of ticket volume by priority
navigation.functional_specs: Pie-Chart on support360_ticket_schema. Criteria: CREATED_DATE range, STATUS (optional). PRIORITY_CODE (segment) vs COUNT_OF_TICKETS (value). Drill to All Tickets filtered by clicked PRIORITY_CODE.

navigation.title: My Open Tickets Count
navigation.description: Card count of employee's own open tickets
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual on support360_ticket_schema. Fixed criteria RAISED_BY = current Employee. COUNT_OF_TICKETS where STATUS in (Open, Assigned, In Progress). Drill to My Tickets filtered to open statuses.

navigation.title: My Tickets Awaiting Confirmation Count
navigation.description: Card count of employee's resolved tickets pending confirmation
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual on support360_ticket_schema. Fixed criteria RAISED_BY = current Employee. COUNT_OF_TICKETS where STATUS = Resolved. Drill to My Tickets filtered to STATUS = Resolved.

navigation.title: My Queue Count
navigation.description: Card count of tickets assigned to current agent
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual on support360_ticket_schema. Fixed criteria ASSIGNED_AGENT = current Agent. COUNT_OF_TICKETS where STATUS in (Assigned, In Progress). Drill to Manage Ticket Queue filtered to current Agent's active tickets.

navigation.title: Unassigned Tickets Count
navigation.description: Card count of unassigned open tickets
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual on support360_ticket_schema. Fixed criteria STATUS = Open. COUNT_OF_TICKETS where STATUS = Open and ASSIGNED_AGENT is blank. Drill to Manage Ticket Queue filtered to unassigned Open tickets.

navigation.title: My Queue by Priority
navigation.description: Bar chart of agent's queue by priority
navigation.functional_specs: Bar-Chart on support360_ticket_schema. Criteria: ASSIGNED_AGENT = current Agent (fixed), STATUS (optional). PRIORITY_CODE (y-axis) vs COUNT_OF_TICKETS (x-axis). Drill to Manage Ticket Queue filtered by clicked PRIORITY_CODE.

navigation.title: Total Open Tickets Count
navigation.description: Card count of all open tickets organization-wide
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual on support360_ticket_schema. No default filter, organization-wide. COUNT_OF_TICKETS where STATUS in (Open, Assigned, In Progress). Drill to All Tickets filtered to open statuses.

navigation.title: Total Resolved This Period Count
navigation.description: Card count of tickets resolved/closed in period
navigation.functional_specs: Card visual on support360_ticket_schema. Criteria: CREATED_DATE range (default current month). COUNT_OF_TICKETS where STATUS in (Resolved, Closed) and LAST_UPDATED_DATE within range. Drill to All Tickets filtered to Resolved/Closed within period.

navigation.title: Tickets by Status Trend
navigation.description: Stacked column chart of daily/weekly ticket volume by status
navigation.functional_specs: Stacked-Column-Chart on support360_ticket_schema. Criteria: CREATED_DATE range (default last 30 days). CREATED_DATE (x-axis, day/week) vs COUNT_OF_TICKETS stacked by STATUS. Drill to All Tickets filtered to clicked date bucket and STATUS.

navigation.title: Ticket Detail Log
navigation.description: Grid of activity log entries across tickets
navigation.functional_specs: Grid visual over the Ticket Activity Log. Criteria: TICKET_NO, CHANGED_BY, CHANGE_DATE range, ACTION_TYPE. Data points: TICKET_NO, ACTION_TYPE, FIELD_CHANGED, OLD_VALUE, NEW_VALUE, CHANGED_BY, CHANGE_DATE. Row click drills to the parent ticket's detail view.

navigation.title: Dashboards
navigation.description: Role-based operational dashboards
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Employee, Support Agent and Admin dashboards

navigation.title: Employee Dashboard
navigation.description: Employee's personal ticket overview
navigation.functional_specs: Dashboard for Employee role. Fixed criteria RAISED_BY = current Employee, CREATED_DATE range default last 90 days (adjustable). Composes My Open Tickets Count (Card), My Tickets Awaiting Confirmation Count (Card), My Tickets by Status (Pie-Chart), My Tickets Grid (Grid: TICKET_NO, TITLE, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, LAST_UPDATED_DATE). Card and Pie drill to My Tickets filtered by clicked STATUS; grid rows drill to ticket detail.

navigation.title: Support Agent Dashboard
navigation.description: Agent's queue and workload overview
navigation.functional_specs: Dashboard for Support Agent role. Fixed criteria ASSIGNED_AGENT = current Agent, CREATED_DATE range default last 30 days (adjustable). Composes My Queue Count (Card), Unassigned Tickets Count (Card, organization-wide), My Queue by Priority (Bar-Chart), My Queue by Status (Column-Chart), My Active Tickets Grid (Grid: TICKET_NO, TITLE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, RAISED_BY, LAST_UPDATED_DATE). Cards/charts drill to Manage Ticket Queue filtered accordingly; grid rows drill to ticket detail.

navigation.title: Admin Dashboard
navigation.description: Organization-wide ticket analytics for Admin
navigation.functional_specs: Dashboard for Admin role. Criteria: CREATED_DATE range default current month (adjustable), CATEGORY_CODE (optional). Composes Total Open Tickets Count (Card), Total Resolved This Period Count (Card), Ticket Count by Status (Column-Chart), Ticket Count by Priority (Pie-Chart), Tickets by Status Trend (Stacked-Column-Chart). All visuals drill to All Tickets filtered by clicked STATUS/PRIORITY_CODE/date bucket.
